examples.title: Blog / CMS Platform
examples.description: A WordPress/Medium-style content management system: authors, posts, pages, categories, tags, comments, and metadata. The canonical "post + taxonomy + comments" schema every CMS reimplements.

examples.title: Chinook — Digital Media Store
examples.description: The popular SQLite sample database for a fictional music (and media) store, modelled after iTunes. Because it ships as a real SQLite file, Chinook is the default play-ground for practicing `JOIN`s, artist/album/track hierarchies, and playlist many-to-many relations on the exact engine this app uses.

examples.title: ClassicModels — B2B Retail Store
examples.description: The MySQL sample database for a model-car wholesaler. Its charm is the `orderdetails` junction table with a composite PK, the `employees` hierarchy, and simple office/customer geography — ideal for teaching realistic reporting queries.

examples.title: E-Commerce Platform
examples.description: A Shopify/Amazon-style retail platform: products with variants, shopping carts, orders, payments, inventory, and customer reviews. This is the schema shape most backend engineers are asked to design in interviews.

examples.title: Oracle HR — Human Resources
examples.description: The classic Oracle "HR" sample schema (`employees` sample) that ships with every Oracle Database install. Famous for teaching the `employees → departments → locations → countries → regions` hierarchy and the `job_history` time-series pattern.

examples.title: Music Streaming Service
examples.description: A Spotify-style streaming platform: artists, albums, tracks, playlists, listening history, subscriptions, and recommendations. A compact schema that exercises every join type and both kinds of many-to-many junctions.

examples.title: Northwind Traders
examples.description: The classic Microsoft sample database for order management — customers, orders, products, suppliers, employees, and shipping. Northwind is the best-known "traders" schema ever shipped with SQL Server / Access.

examples.title: Project Management (Kanban)
examples.description: A Trello/Jira/Asana-style board tool: workspaces, boards, lists, cards, labels, assignees, comments, and activity. A great demonstration of ordered lists, many-to-many tagging, and audit trails.

examples.title: Sakila — DVD Rental Store
examples.description: The modern MySQL sample database for a movie rental shop. Sakila replaces the older "world" and "employees" samples and is the go-to schema for teaching joins, actors/films many-to-many relations, and payment reporting.

examples.title: Social Media Platform
examples.description: A Twitter/X-style microblogging service: users, posts (tweets), replies, likes, follows, mentions, and direct messages. The classic "fan-out" and adjacency-list graph modelling case study.
